BLOCKERS.md.label: Blockers
BLOCKERS.md.help_text: This file is injected into `drydock analyze` and `drydock plan create` when it exists. Answer the blocking questions directly in this file; use it to record resolved guidance and clear it when the blockers no longer apply.
BLOCKERS.md.prompt_text: Section defines existing blockers and user responses to the stated concern. Use answers as resolved guidance and do not re-raise them unless still unresolved.

COMPASS.md.label: Compass
COMPASS.md.help_text: This file is injected into every `drydock` command for this target. Keep durable project intent, constraints, and guardrails here so downstream commands stay aligned.
COMPASS.md.prompt_text: Section defines the core project intent, constraints, and guardrails for this target. Treat it as durable steering and follow it across all commands.

ANALYZE_COMPASS.md.label: Analyze Compass
ANALYZE_COMPASS.md.help_text: This file is injected into every `drydock analyze` run for this target. You can adjust the behavior of future drydock Analyze commands with this text.
ANALYZE_COMPASS.md.prompt_text: Section Defines standing user steering for this specific llm run.

PLAN_COMPASS.md.label: Plan Compass
PLAN_COMPASS.md.help_text: This file is injected into every `drydock plan create` run for this target. You can adjust the behavior of future plan-generation runs with this text.
PLAN_COMPASS.md.prompt_text: Section defines standing user steering for this specific plan-generation run.

EXCLUDE_FILES.md.default_text:
# Exclude Files

Exact filenames listed here are excluded from `blueprint/sources/` prompt injection for `drydock analyze` and `drydock plan`.

## Excluded files
EXCLUDE_FILES.md.help_text: This file controls which imported source filenames are excluded from prompt injection for `drydock analyze` and `drydock plan create`. List exact filenames, one per bullet, when a source should stay out of future LLM context.
EXCLUDE_FILES.md.prompt_text: Section defines exact imported source filenames to exclude from analyze and plan prompt assembly. Treat listed filenames as omitted context.
